integrity: All results derive from exact Kummer-cover arguments, finite-field point counts and finite affine-orbit verification. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Precisely sixteen constant square-class deck twists of a fixed five-rational-branch Humbert cover; not all abstract arithmetic twists or all Humbert curves. Jacobian decomposition is already known. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Three arithmetic isomorphism classes among the sixteen five-branch Humbert twists over \(\mathbb F_5\)
